name: Hofbräustüberl Garmisch
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hofbräustüberl Garmisch in Tirol!**

Experience authentic Bavarian hospitality in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy beer garden invites you to relax with a refreshing **Hofbräu** beer, paired with hearty Bavarian dishes like **Schweinsbraten**, **Obatzda**, or a classic **Kaiserschmarrn**.

Enjoy the mountain views while savoring traditional flavors—just a short stroll from the lively center of **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**. Whether you're here for skiing, hiking, or simply unwinding, our rustic charm and warm atmosphere make every visit unforgettable.

**Prost!** 🍻
